text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, it seems it's about time
to replace my track jacket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Moving around, I feel tightness in a few spots.
Looks like I've gained some muscle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, meat truly reigns supreme.
It's great for muscles, too. No doubt about it.

Out of curiosity, I checked the results of
this morning's physical measurements. And then—
choice_data_list: Looks like skeletal muscle percentage is down a little bit...
Looks like my skeletal muscle percentage dropped a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: So in other words, what increased was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wipe that smirk off your face.
Dammit...!

As a result of relentless, reckless running,
Narita Brian successfully lost weight!
